STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: mg_05585_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: mg_05585_combined.v · Open raw
module mg_05585(input clk,input enable,input [7:0] data_in,output [7:0] data_out,input [12:0] addr_in,input reg_we_rising);
reg [7:0] obc1_regs [7:0]; 
 wire [6:0] oam_number = obc1_regs[6][6:0]; 
 wire obc_bank = obc1_regs[5][0]; 
 wire low_en = enable & ((addr_in & 13'h1a00) == 13'h1800); 
 wire high_en = enable & ((addr_in & 13'h1a00) == 13'h1a00); 
 wire reg_en = enable & ((addr_in & 13'h1ff8) == 13'h1ff0); 
 wire [2:0] obc_reg = addr_in[2:0]; 
 wire oam_low_we = enable & (reg_we_rising) & (((addr_in & 13'h1ffc) == 13'h1ff0) | low_en); 
 wire oam_high_we = enable & (reg_we_rising) & (addr_in == 13'h1ff4); 
 wire snes_high_we = enable & (reg_we_rising) & high_en; 
 wire [9:0] oam_low_addr = (~reg_en) ? addr_in[9:0] : {~obc_bank, oam_number, addr_in[1:0]}; 
 wire [7:0] oam_high_addr = (~reg_en) ? addr_in[5:0] : {~obc_bank, oam_number}; 
 wire [7:0] low_douta; 
 wire [7:0] high_doutb; 
 `ifdef MK2 
 obc_lower oam_low (.clka(clk),.wea(oam_low_we),.addra(oam_low_addr),.dina(data_in),.douta(low_douta)); 
 obc_upper oam_high (.clka(clk),.wea(oam_high_we),.addra(oam_high_addr),.dina(data_in[1:0]),.douta(douta),.clkb(clk),.web(snes_high_we),.addrb(addr_in[5:0]),.dinb(data_in),.doutb(high_doutb)); 
 `endif 
 `ifdef MK3 
 obc_lower oam_low (.clock(clk),.wren(oam_low_we),.address(oam_low_addr),.data(data_in),.q(low_douta)); 
 obc_upper oam_high (.clock(clk),.wren_a(oam_high_we),.address_a(oam_high_addr),.data_a(data_in[1:0]),.q_a(douta),.wren_b(snes_high_we),.address_b(addr_in[5:0]),.data_b(data_in),.q_b(high_doutb)); 
 `endif 
 assign data_out = reg_en ? obc1_regs[addr_in[2:0]] 
  : low_en ? low_douta 
  : high_en ? high_doutb 
  : 8'h77; 
 always @(posedge clk) begin 
  if(reg_en & reg_we_rising) begin 
  obc1_regs[obc_reg] <= data_in; 
  end 
 end 
 endmodule

Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.
